plain: Truthfulness; the habit of telling the truth

webster.text: Habitual observance of truth, or habitual truth; as a man of veracity.

example.quote: for, from the best information I have been able to collect from gentlemen of observation and of undoubted veracity, there is the greatest reason to fear that the rejection of this Constitution will be followed with anarchy and confusion.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Rev. Mr. STILLMAN, February 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
